raw.name: Ehlel
raw.description:
A dormant peer has appeared on the public mesh. Its operator is gone, its
protocol is undocumented, and the only artifact it leaves behind is a
MIPS binary that knows how to find its way home.

Download the artifact, keep it isolated, and recover what the peer is
holding for your team.

> [!CONNECTION]
> https://ehlel-r4somizd.challenge.2026.haruulzangi.mn
raw.author: flame
